decision_notes: Accept all four source-family recommendations before authoring. Bind their exact bytes in the fresh author and source/gold-review prompts and resulting review evidence.
Do not use copied or declared adapted primitives alone as fresh primary task families. Merge equivalent embedded/imported behavior into one correlated component.

The bounded no-match source comparison does not prove absence from training or all historical reuse. Old clean heldout count remains zero; prior unknown custody is not repaired.
